title: S11: Migration and reset can run concurrently

description: Each service has its own reentrancy guard, but both operate on the same PersistenceHost; ResetSignalMonitor is fully automatic and migration-unaware, so tearDownStore can race flushAndSwap's critical section. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 2, plan 2a migration-transitions. Sweep: sync machinery. Class-killer: shared DestructiveOpGate replaces the two private reentrancy guards and makes ResetSignalMonitor migration-aware.
